mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a proxy for overall economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods with sustained increases in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate, signals a strengthening labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreased.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals a surge in consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index over three months signals inflationary pressure, which leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods with sustained increases in CPI.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a decline in GDP and an increase in the unemployment rate signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 declined and UNRATE increased.
